title: Microsoft 365 Apps is on a slow channel or has no channel set

report.title: {Items.Count} Microsoft 365 Apps {Plural(Items.Count, 'deployment is', 'deployments are')} on a slow or unset channel

messages.businessImpact: Security fixes for the office suite arrive months later than they could, and the suite is the most common route into an organisation.
remediation: Move the broad population to Monthly Enterprise Channel, keeping Semi-Annual only where an add-in genuinely requires it.
messages.cannotSee: A deployment that sets no channel is reported beside the slow ones, because what a device then does is Microsoft's own default rather than something this tool can read. Which channels count as slow is reference data the pack carries, so a channel added after this pack is not judged.
